name: 22485 · King George, VA
findings: ZIP 22485 (King George) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22485 (King George) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22485 (King George) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
